blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textsc{Rel-Bloom} is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini model. Second, Evaluate items remain a bottleneck even for models near ceiling on the other task types: Gemini~3.1 Pro averages 99.5\% on the other four levels but 60.7\% on Evaluate. Third, item- and relation-level difficulty rankings are consistently preserved across languages, indicating a difficulty structure partly shared across languages within this benchmark. Across knowledge conditions, Counterfactual contexts are generally harder than Factual ones, while removing entity identities can improve higher-level performance in some model regimes. Greater model capability therefore does not by itself ensure reliable reasoning over supplied relational evidence. Relevant resources are available at: https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/non-parametric-memory-relational-reasoning.
blocks.zh: 检索增强的生成(RAG)假设语言模型可以解释其上下文所述的关系,而不是回到在预训期间被记住的协会。 我们孤立地研究这种以证据为条件的关系推理,直接提供事实,而不是直接取回。 \textsc{Rel-Bloom}是一种从30 Wikidata关系建立起来的450个多选择问题的受控多语言诊断;同样的源关系在五个Bloom启发级别(记住,理解,应用,分析,评价)和三个真实条件下(事实,反事实,中立)被即时化. 在43个模型、6种语言和2个多语种环境(226 800个预测)中,有3个结论突出。 首先,在每个评估的开放重量模型系列中,精度从应用到分析急剧下降,大花岗岩桶的精度达到47.2个百分点,但双子座模型均没有达到47.2个百分点. 第二,我们... 即便对其他任务类型接近上限的模型而言,评价项目仍是一个瓶颈:双子座~3.1 其他四个级别平均有99.5×××, 而评价为60.7×××。 第三,各语文之间始终保留项目和关系级难度排名,表明在本基准内各语文之间部分共享的困难结构。 在整个知识条件下,反事实环境一般比事实环境更困难,而去除实体身份可以提高一些模型制度中的更高水平的性能. 因此,增强模型能力本身并不能确保就所提供的关系证据进行可靠的推理。 有关资源可在以下网址查阅:https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/n-parameroy-memory-relation-reasoning。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models are increasingly deployed in knowledge-intensive settings, most notably retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where a model must reason over facts supplied in its context rather than rely solely on information acquired during pretraining ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) . A fundamental challenge in evaluating such systems is separating answers grounded in the supplied evidence from answers driven by memorized associations: a model may answer correctly by drawing on parametric knowledge about a named entity, or answer incorrectly because that knowledge conflicts with the relation stated in context ( Longpre et al., 2021 ) . Existing benchmarks rarely operationalize this distinction directly, so high accuracy does not by itself show whether a model follows the supplied evidence. End-to-end RAG evaluations further confound this question with retrieval quality. We therefore remove retrieval and supply the relevant fact directly in the prompt, measuring accuracy on evidence-conditioned relational questions as a diagnostic of one component on which RAG systems depend.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地被部署在知识密集型环境中,最显著的是检索-增强生成(RAG),在这种环境中,一个模型必须针对其上下文提供的事实提出理由,而不只是依赖在培训前获得的信息(Lewis等人,2020年)。 评估这类系统的一个根本挑战是,将基于所提供证据的答案与基于被记忆的关联的答案区分开来:一个模型可能利用关于一个被命名实体的参数化知识来正确回答,或者错误回答,因为这种知识与上下文所述的关系相冲突(Longpre等人,2021年)。 现有的基准很少直接实施这种区分,因此,高度准确性本身并不表明一个模型是否遵循所提供的证据。 从端到端的RAG评价进一步将这一问题与检索质量混为一谈。 因此,我们取消了检索,并直接提供相关事实,即时对证据证明的关联问题进行精确度的衡量,以诊断RAG系统所依赖的一个部分。

blocks.en: Bloom’s revised taxonomy ( Krathwohl, 2002 ) offers a principled framework for characterizing the cognitive complexity of tasks, organizing cognitive processes into six hierarchical levels: Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, and Create. Originally designed to classify human learning objectives, the taxonomy has been adopted in NLP and LLM research to evaluate models across varying depths of reasoning ( Fei et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2024 ; Abootorabi et al., 2026 ) . A critical assumption underlying such work remains insufficiently tested, however: whether accuracy on Bloom-inspired task types, designed from a taxonomy of human learning objectives, follows the ordering the taxonomy implies. In particular, stronger models may not show a monotonic decline in accuracy across levels, and different level transitions may be associated with different patterns of error.
blocks.zh: Bloom修订的分类学(Krathwohl, 2002)为描述任务的认知复杂性提供了一个原则框架,将认知过程组织到六个层次: 记住、理解、应用、分析、评价和创建。 最初旨在将人类学习目标分类的分类学在NLP和LLM研究中被采用来评价不同深度的推理模型(Fei等,2024;Cao等,2024;Abootorabi等,2026.). 然而,这种工作所依据的一个关键假设仍未得到充分检验:根据人类学习目标分类法设计的Bloom启发任务类型的准确性是否遵循分类法的含义。 特别是更强的模型可能不会显示各级别精度的单调下降,不同级别过渡可能与不同的出错模式有关.

blocks.en: Multilingual evaluation adds a further dimension to this challenge. Benchmarks such as XTREME ( Hu et al., 2020 ) and MEGA ( Ahuja et al., 2023 ) have established cross-lingual performance baselines, yet multilingual evaluations have largely focused on whether models can perform tasks across languages. Less attention has been paid to whether the underlying structure of model behavior itself is stable across languages: whether the same items and relations remain difficult, whether models exhibit similar sensitivity to knowledge format, and whether cognitive difficulty profiles and interference from memorized associations reflect shared model behavior or language-specific artifacts.
blocks.zh: 多语种评价为这一挑战增加了又一层面。 XTREME(Hu等,2020年)和MEGA(Ahuja等,2023年)等基准设定了跨语言性能基线,而多语言评价则主要侧重于模型是否能够完成跨语言的任务. 对于模型行为本身的基本结构是否在各语言之间是稳定的,没有那么重视:相同的项目和关系是否仍然困难,模型是否对知识格式表现出相近的敏感性,以及认知难度描述和被记忆的关联的干扰是否反映了共同的模型行为或语言特有文物.

blocks.en: We address these gaps simultaneously with Rel-Bloom , a multilingual diagnostic benchmark for evaluating how language models reason over supplied relational knowledge. Rel-Bloom contains 450 multiple-choice questions grounded in 30 curated Wikidata relations ( Wang et al., 2021 ) . Each question is instantiated under three veracity conditions: Factual, in which real entities are paired with the correct relation; Counterfactual, in which one entity is replaced with an incorrect real entity while preserving the relation; and Neutralized, in which entity identities are replaced with typed abstract placeholders. This design allows us to vary the degree to which parametric entity associations can assist or interfere with reasoning over the supplied context. Questions span five levels adapted from Bloom’s revised taxonomy: Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, and Evaluate, with Create omitted because it is not naturally compatible with controlled multiple-choice evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们与Rel-Bloom同时解决这些差距,后者是一个多语种诊断基准,用于评估语言模型如何解释如何提供关系知识。 Rel-Bloom包含450个多选题,基于30个被曲解的维基数据关系(Wang等,2021年). 每个问题在三个真实条件下即时提出: 事实,其中实体与正确关系对等; 反事实,其中一个实体在保留关系的同时被不正确的实体所取代; 中立化,其中实体身份被打入抽象占位符所取代. 这种设计使我们能够改变参数实体协会能够协助或干预所提供上下文的推理的程度。 问题跨越五个级别, 由Bloom修订的分类学: 记住、理解、应用、分析和评价,

blocks.en: We evaluate 43 models: 41 open-weight models from seven model families, analyzed as eight model series (Qwen2.5 Base, Qwen2.5 Instruct, Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Gemma, LLaMA, Granite, and DeepSeek, with the Qwen2.5 family split into Base and Instruct series), together with two closed-weight Gemini models. Evaluation covers six languages, Arabic, Chinese, English, Hindi, Persian, and Spanish, and two multilingual settings, yielding 226,800 predictions. Our analysis considers model scale, Bloom cognitive level, knowledge veracity, relation usage frequency, and language. Matched accuracy contrasts are evaluated using relation-clustered inference over the 30 source relations, while cross-language stability is assessed using dedicated correlation-based procedures.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了43个模型:来自7个模型家庭的41个开放重量模型,被分析为8个模型系列(Quen2.5 Base,Quen2.5 Instruct,Quen3,Quen3.5,Gemma,LLaMA,Granite,和DeepSeek),由Quen2.5家族分出为Base和Instruct系列),以及两个封闭重量双子模型. 评价涵盖六种语言,即阿拉伯语、中文、英语、印地语、波斯语和西班牙语,以及两种多语种环境,预测结果为226 800个。 我们的分析考虑了模型尺度,Bloom认知水平,知识真实性,关系使用频率,以及语言. 使用30个源关系的关系分组推论来评价匹配的准确性对比,而跨语言稳定性则使用基于关联的专门程序来评估.

blocks.en: (i) Benchmark and experimental design. Rel-Bloom instantiates the same 30 usage-stratified Wikidata relations at five Bloom-inspired levels and under three matched veracity conditions (450 English MCQs), translated into six languages under two evaluation settings, with ten pre-specified hypotheses tested by relation-clustered inference. (ii) Findings on Bloom levels and knowledge conditions. Accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every open-weight model series, but not for Gemini, while Evaluate remains a bottleneck even for models near ceiling on the other levels; Counterfactual contexts are generally the hardest condition, and in many open-weight regimes removing entity identities helps more at Analyze and Evaluate than at Remember and Understand. Scaling generally improves accuracy, with series-dependent trajectories. (iii) Multilingual stability. Item- and relation-level difficulty rankings are consistently positively correlated across the six languages. This suggests that Rel-Bloom captures a difficulty structure that is partly shared across languages, despite differences in language-specific performance.
blocks.zh: (一) 基准和实验设计。 Rel-Bloom即时将相同的30个使用级的Wikidata关系分5个Bloom启发级别,在3个相匹配的真实条件下(450个英语MCQs),在两个评价设置下被翻译成了6个语言,其中10个预先指定的假设通过关系分组推论测试. (二) 关于布鲁姆水平和知识条件的调查结果。 准确性从每个开量模型系列的应用到分析急剧下降,但双子座则不然,而对于接近上限的模型来说,评价仍然是一个瓶颈; 反事实环境通常是最困难的条件,在许多取去实体身份的开量系统中,比起记忆和理解,在分析和评价方面帮助更多。 缩放一般提高精度,具有系列依赖的轨迹. (三)多语种稳定性. 项目级和关系级难度排名在六种语文之间一直呈正相关关系。 这表明Rel-Bloom捕捉到一种难度结构,尽管语言特定性能不同,但该结构在语言之间有部分共享.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work sits at the intersection of three active research threads: cognitive-complexity benchmarking of LLMs, context faithfulness under knowledge conflicts, and the evaluation of reasoning in retrieval-augmented and knowledge-graph settings.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作位于三个积极研究线索的交汇点:LLMs的认知-复杂度基准,知识冲突下的背景忠诚度,以及检索强化和知识图环境中的推理评价.

blocks.en: 2.1 Bloom’s Taxonomy as a Cognitive Complexity Framework for LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 Bloom的分类学作为法学硕士的认知复杂性框架

blocks.en: Bloom’s revised taxonomy ( Krathwohl, 2002 ) has become a widely adopted scaffold for stratifying the cognitive demands placed on language models, moving evaluation beyond aggregate accuracy toward a diagnosis of where competence breaks down. Early adoption appeared in domain-specific benchmarks such as LawBench ( Fei et al., 2024 ) and scientific evaluation suites such as SciEval ( Sun et al., 2024 ) and SciAssess ( Cai et al., 2025 ) . Subsequent work extended this to law ( Dong et al., 2025 ) , medicine ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , software engineering ( Ma et al., 2025 ) , and biographical reasoning ( Cekinmez et al., 2025 ) , consistently revealing that performance degrades at higher cognitive levels. StructEval ( Cao et al., 2024 ) generates test instances automatically for all six levels, while Khoramfar et al. (2026) report accuracy drops of up to 70% as tasks ascend the hierarchy, echoing findings from Todorovikj et al. (2025) , who apply Bloom’s framework to characterize tasks in knowledge-graph benchmarks. BloomWise ( Zoumpoulidi et al., 2025 ) reveals a non-monotonic pattern in mathematical reasoning: models score higher on Apply than on Understand; we do not reproduce this ordering in the relational setting. Raimondi and Gabbrielli (2026) further argue, via mechanistic probing, that Bloom’s levels correspond to distinguishable internal representations.
blocks.zh: Bloom修订的分类学(Krathwohl,2002年)已经成为一个被广泛采纳的脚手架,用来划分对语言模型的认知需求,使评价超越了总的准确性,转向对能力崩溃的诊断。 早期的采用出现在Law Bench(Fei等,2024年)和SciEval(Sun等,2024年)和SciAssess(Cai等,2025年)等特定领域基准中. 随后的作品将它扩展到了法律(董等,2025年),医学(周等,2025年),软件工程(马等,2025年),和传记推理(Cekinmez等,2025年),一致揭示了性能在更高的认知水平会退化. 结构 Eval(Cao等人,2024年)自动生成所有六级的测试实例,而Khoramfar等人(2026年)报告说,随着任务跨越等级,精确度下降至70%,这与Todorovikj等人(2025年)的结论相呼应,后者应用了Bloom的框架来描述知识图基准中的任务。 BloomWise(Zoumpoulidi等,2025年)在数学推理中揭示出一种非模拟模式:模型在应用上的得分高于在理解上的得分;我们不会在关联环境中再现这种顺序. Raimondi和Gabbrielli(2026年)通过机械测试进一步认为,Bloom的水平与可区分的内部表述相对应.

blocks.en: Gap. None of these benchmarks jointly control (i) matched items across Bloom levels, (ii) factual/counterfactual/entity-neutralized conditions of the same relation, and (iii) multiple languages. Rel-Bloom brings these dimensions together on a single, item-matched design.
blocks.zh: 差距. 这些基准没有一项共同控制:(一) 与Bloom各级的项目相匹配;(二) 同一关系的事实/事实/实体中立条件;(三) 多语种。 Rel-Bloom将这些维度集中在一个单一的,项目相配的设计上.

blocks.en: 2.2 Context Faithfulness Under Knowledge Conflicts
blocks.zh: 2.2 知识冲突下的信仰

blocks.en: A parallel line of work studies whether models ground responses in supplied context or default to memorized knowledge. Longpre et al. (2021) formalize this as an entity-level knowledge conflict, measuring models’ tendency to favor parametric answers over counterfactual context. Li et al. (2023) demonstrate that large models exhibit poor controllability in conflict scenarios and introduce Knowledge-Aware Fine-Tuning (KAFT), incorporating counterfactual and irrelevant contexts to improve robustness. Basmov et al. (2024) show that faithfulness further degrades for hypothetically or modally framed contexts, while Meng et al. (2022) provide mechanistic evidence linking this behavior to localized factual associations stored in mid-layer feed-forward modules. Liu et al. (2025) introduce a generative framework for relational reasoning that recreates classic cognitive-science paradigms, such as transitive inference and the symbolic distance effect, and report that several human reasoning biases reappear in LLMs. Gap. Prior work characterizes when parametric associations override supplied context but rarely varies cognitive demand on the same relation. Rel-Bloom adds a Neutralized condition, which removes entity-identity cues without introducing a conflict, and traces how parametric interference scales with Bloom level.
blocks.zh: 平行的工作领域研究,无论是在提供上下文中模型地面反应还是默认记忆知识。 Longpre等人(2021年)将这一点正式确定为实体层面的知识冲突,衡量模型倾向于偏好参数化答案而不是反事实背景。 Li等人(2023年)表明,大型模型在冲突情况下的可控性很差,并引入了知识-知识精通(KAFT),结合了反事实和不相干的背景,以提高稳健性. Basmov等人(2024年)表明,根据假设或模式设定的背景,忠诚度进一步退化,而Meng等人则进一步退化。 (2022)提供机械证据,将这种行为与存储在中层向导模块中的局部事实关联联系起来. 刘等. (2025年)引入了关系推理的基因框架,重现了经典认知-科学范式,如过渡性推论和符号距离效应等,并报告在LLMS中再现了几种人类推理偏差. 差距. 先前的工作特征是,参数结合超越了所提供的上下文,但很少改变对同一关系的认知需求。 Rel-Bloom 添加了中性化条件,在不引入冲突的情况下去除实体识别提示,并追踪参数干扰如何与 Bloom 级别相比.

blocks.en: 2.3 RAG Reasoning and Knowledge-Graph QA
blocks.zh: 2.3 RAG 理由和知识 -- -- 质量评估

blocks.en: The original RAG framework ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) demonstrated that combining parametric memory with non-parametric retrieval improves factuality on knowledge-intensive tasks. Pan et al. (2024) survey the landscape of LLM–KG integration, and GraphRAG variants ( Thompson et al., 2025 ) leverage entity-relation graphs for multi-hop traversal and associative retrieval. Sarthi et al. (2024) organize documents into hierarchical summaries for improved retrieval. Zhang et al. (2025) report that the average factual correctness rate across 16 popular KGQA datasets is only 57%, and Lin et al. (2026) propose HybridRAG-Bench to control for parametric memorization. Todorovikj et al. (2025) specifically examine how Bloom’s taxonomy can characterize KG tasks, identifying gaps in coverage of higher-order reasoning. Gap. Existing RAG/KGQA benchmarks measure whether the retrieved context is used, but not how well the model understands the specific relation carried by that context. Rel-Bloom targets this by evaluating matched relations across factual, counterfactual, and neutralized instantiations of the same triple.
blocks.zh: 最初的RAG框架(Lewis等,2020年)表明,将参数记忆与非参数检索相结合可以提高知识密集型任务的事实性. Pan等人(2024年)调查了LLM-KG集成的地平面,以及GraphRAG变体(Thompson等人,2025年)利用实体关系图来进行多跳转和相干回取. Sarthi等人(2024年)将文件整理成分级摘要,以改进检索。 张等(2025年)报告说,16个受欢迎KGQA数据集的平均实际正确率只有57%,而Lin等. (2026)提议HybridRAG-Bench控制以进行参数化的记忆. Todorovikj等 (2025年) 专门研究了 Bloom 的分类学如何描述 KG 任务, 找出高序推理的覆盖范围空白. 差距. 现有RAG/KGQA基准衡量是否使用检索到的上下文,但模型对上下文所带具体关系的了解程度不高。 Rel-Bloom通过评估事实、反事实的对应关系,以及消除同一三起事件的即时反应,来实现这一目标。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准概览

blocks.en: We introduce Rel-Bloom , a compact diagnostic benchmark for sentence-level understanding of Wikidata-style relations. Each item consists of a fact sentence, a multiple-choice question with four answer options, and metadata describing the Bloom level, veracity condition, and relation usage tier. Rel-Bloom spans five Bloom-inspired cognitive levels, Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, and Evaluate, with 90 questions per level, totalling 450 questions. We omit the sixth level (Create) because it requires open-ended generation that is incompatible with a controlled multiple-choice format. Within each Bloom level, questions are distributed equally across three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, and Neutralized, 30 questions each), and each set of 30 is further balanced across three relation usage tiers (High, Medium, and Low, 10 questions each).
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Rel-Bloom, 一个紧凑的诊断基准, 用于句子层面的理解 维基数据风格的关系。 每个项目包含一个事实句,一个包含四个答案选项的多选择问题,以及描述 Bloom 级别,真实性条件,和关系使用级的元数据. Rel-Bloom跨越了五个被Bloom启发的认知水平,记住,理解,应用,分析,以及评价,每个水平有90个问题,共计450个问题. 我们省略了第六关(Create),因为它需要与被控制的多选择格式相不相容的可自由的生成. 在每个Bloom级别内,问题在三个真实条件(事实、反事实和中立,每组30个问题)中分布平等,每组30个问题在三个关系使用级别(高、中和低,每组10个问题)中进一步平衡。

blocks.en: 3.2 Relation Selection and Usage Tiers
blocks.zh: 3.2 关系选择和使用级别

blocks.en: We draw candidate relations from Wikidata5M ( Wang et al., 2021 ) and stratify them into Low, Medium, and High usage tiers using MediaWiki property-frequency counts as a proxy for relation prevalence. These counts approximate how often a relation is used in Wikidata; they are not estimates of how often the relation appears in model pretraining data or of how strongly it is memorized, and we interpret relation usage frequency results (H6) accordingly. We manually curate 10 relations per tier, yielding 30 source relations. The complete sampling, frequency transformation, and stratification procedure is provided in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们从Wikidata5M(Wang等,2021年)中绘制候选关系,并将其分级为低,中,高等使用级,使用MediaWiki属性频率计数作为关系流行的代名词. 这些统计大致计算了Wikidata中使用关系的次数;它们不是模型预训数据中这种关系出现频率的估计,也不是对它被记住的程度的估计,我们据此解释关系使用频率结果(H6). 我们手动管理每层10个关系,产生30个源关系. 完整的取样、频率转换和分层程序载于附录A.4。

blocks.en: 3.3 Triple Extraction and Manual Curation
blocks.zh: 3.3 三重提取和手动校正

blocks.en: For each candidate relation, we extract one representative factual triple ( h , p , t ) (h,p,t) and manually curate a final set of 30 relations, with 10 from each usage tier. Curation prioritizes semantic clarity, domain diversity, and non-overlapping entities, while excluding sensitive or excessively technical relations. Each selected relation contributes one source triple that is reused across Bloom levels and veracity conditions, prioritizing controlled comparison over broad relation coverage. Relation-level results therefore describe these 30 relation instances; effects attributed to a relation may partly reflect the particular entities and fact chosen for it. Further extraction and curation details are provided in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 对于每个候选关系,我们提取一个具有代表性的三重事实(h,p,t (h,p,t)),并手动整理出一套由30个关系组成的最终关系,其中10个关系来自每个使用级别。 校正优先注重语义清晰,领域多样性,以及不重叠的实体,同时排除敏感或过度的技术关系. 每个选定的关系都贡献了一个来源的三分之一,在Bloom级别和真实性条件中重复使用,将控制性比较置于广泛的关系覆盖范围之上。 因此,关系层面的结果说明了这30个关系实例;归属于关系的影响可能部分反映了特定实体和为其选择的事实。 附录A.4提供了进一步的提取和整理细节。

blocks.en: 3.4 Fact Verbalization and Question Generation
blocks.zh: 3.4 事实化和问题产生

blocks.en: For each extracted triple ( h , p , t ) (h,p,t) , GPT-5 1 1 1 We accessed GPT-5 in early 2026. All verbalized facts were subsequently verified manually by the authors. verbalizes the fact and assists in generating level-specific multiple-choice questions. Table 1 summarizes the operationalization of the five Bloom levels.
blocks.zh: 每取出三分(h,p,t) (h,p,t),GPT-5 1 1,我们于2026年初访问GPT-5. 提交人随后对所有口头陈述的事实进行了人工核实。 口头解说事实,并会帮助生成不同层次的多选择问题. 表1汇总了Bloom五级的运行情况.

blocks.en: The levels differ in the operation a question requires, and therefore also in how questions and distractors are constructed. Analyze distractors are near-miss relations that can be rejected by checking them against the stated fact, whereas Evaluate distractors are plausible statements about the relation that are not its defining criterion and cannot be rejected in this way. Differences in question construction and distractor difficulty may therefore contribute to accuracy differences between levels. We interpret level-wise gaps as differences in accuracy on these operationalized task types, not as direct measurements of distinct cognitive abilities.
blocks.zh: 问题要求的操作水平不同,因此问题和分心器的构造也不同。 分析分心者是近乎错觉的关系,通过对照所述事实加以检查,可以拒绝这种关系,而评估分心者则是关于这种关系的可信陈述,这些陈述不是其决定性标准,不能以这种方式拒绝。 因此,问题构建方面的差异和分散注意力的困难可能导致不同级别之间的准确性差异。 我们把水平差距解释为这些可操作的任务类型的准确性差异,而不是直接衡量不同的认知能力。

blocks.en: All generated questions, answer options, and answer keys are manually reviewed for factual correctness, preservation of the intended relation, answer uniqueness, and distractor plausibility. As an additional validation pass, Gemini and Grok independently flag disagreements with the provided answers; all flagged cases are manually inspected, and ambiguous items are revised and re-evaluated. Additional quality-control details are provided in Appendix A.5 .

blocks.en: 3.5 Veracity Conditions
blocks.zh: 3.5 机动性条件

blocks.en: To separate the contributions of entity-specific prior knowledge, evidence-following, and relational abstraction, we construct three matched veracity conditions for each Bloom level, summarized in Table 2 . The variants preserve the underlying relation and Bloom-level question structure, enabling controlled comparisons across Factual, Counterfactual, and Neutralized conditions. The Counterfactual condition is designed to conflict with knowledge a model is likely to hold about well-known entities; we do not directly measure whether each model has memorized each source fact, so Counterfactual effects indicate sensitivity to likely prior-knowledge conflict rather than verified memorization.
blocks.zh: 为了区分特定实体先前的知识、证据跟踪和关系抽象的贡献,我们为Bloom的每个层面构建了三个相应的真实条件,见表2。 这些变体保留了基础关系和Bloom级问题结构,从而能够对事实、反事实和中立条件进行有控制的比较。 反事实条件旨在与知识相冲突,一个模型可能持有着众所周知的实体;我们并不直接衡量每个模型是否记住了每个来源的事实,因此反事实效应表明对可能的知识冲突具有敏感性,而不是经过核实的记忆。

blocks.en: 3.6 Multilingual Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: 3.6 多语种评价设置

blocks.en: Rel-Bloom is constructed in English and evaluated in Arabic, Chinese, English, Hindi, Persian, and Spanish under two settings. In the hybrid cross-lingual setting , the fact and question remain in English while the answer options are translated into the target language, isolating cross-lingual answer selection from a shared English stimulus. In the fully translated setting , the fact, question, and options are all presented in the target language while preserving the relation, Bloom-level operation, veracity condition, answer key, and option order. We analyze the two settings separately.
blocks.zh: Rel-Bloom以英文建造,在两种情况下用阿拉伯文、中文、英文、印地语、波斯文和西班牙文进行评价。 在混合的跨语言设置中,事实和问题仍然用英语表达,而答案选项则被翻译为目标语言,将跨语言答案选择从共享英语刺激中隔离出. 在被完全翻译的设置中,事实,问题和选项都以目标语言呈现,同时保留关系,Bloom级操作,真实性条件,答案密钥,和选项顺序. 我们分别分析这两个设置.

blocks.en: Model checkpoints (Appendix A.1 ), benchmark construction (Appendix A.4 ), quality control (Appendix A.5 ), and hypothesis-specific test statistics, permutation/cluster-bootstrap procedures, and the Holm correction family (Appendix A.2 ) are documented. The complete benchmark, translations, prompt templates, decoding configurations, and per-model prediction logs will be released upon publication.

blocks.en: 3.7 Hypothesis Testing Framework
blocks.zh: 3.7 假设测试框架

blocks.en: We evaluate ten pre-specified (not publicly preregistered) hypotheses spanning model scale, Bloom-level difficulty, veracity, relation usage frequency, and cross-language stability, listed in Table 3 . For scale-dependent analyses, open-weight models are grouped into Small ( < 7 <7 B), Medium ( ≥ 7 \geq 7 B and < 14 <14 B), and Large ( ≥ 14 \geq 14 B) buckets; Gemini models are reported individually because their parameter counts are undisclosed. Checkpoints within a bucket and across buckets also differ in training data, recipe, and in some cases architecture (Appendix A.1 ), so size-bucket comparisons are descriptive rather than causal estimates of scaling effects.

blocks.en: 4.1 Scaling Behavior
blocks.zh: 4.1 放大行为

blocks.en: Accuracy generally increases with model size ( H2 ). In the fully translated setting, Medium significantly exceeds Small in all eight open-weight series, while Large significantly exceeds Medium in seven; DeepSeek is the only exception. The same broad pattern holds in the hybrid cross-lingual setting. For example, Qwen2.5 Instruct gains 23.8 percentage points from Small to Medium and 6.1 points from Medium to Large.
blocks.zh: 准确度一般随着模型大小(H2)而增加. 在被完全翻译的设定中,Medium在所有8个开口量系列中显著地超过Small,而Large在7个中显著地超过Medium;DeepSeek是唯一的例外. 同样的广义模式存在于混合的跨文化环境中。 例如,Quen2.5指令从中小得到23.8%,从中大得到6.1个百分点。

blocks.en: Diminishing returns ( H1 ) are less universal, holding in five of eight series in the fully translated setting and six of eight in the hybrid cross-lingual setting. LLaMA and Granite show larger upper-transition gains, while DeepSeek supports ( H1 ) only in the hybrid cross-lingual setting and slightly declines from Medium to Large when fully translated. Qwen2.5 Base and Instruct show similar scaling trends.
blocks.zh: diminishing return (H1)的通用性较弱,在全译语设置中以8个系列中的5个为主,在混合跨语设置中以8个系列中的6个为主. LLaMA和Granite显示出较大的上过渡收益,而DeepSeek只支持混合跨语言环境(H1),在完全被翻译后从中大略下降. Quen2.5 Base和Instruct显示类似的缩放趋势.

blocks.en: 4.2 Bloom-Level Patterns
blocks.zh: 4.2 布鲁姆级模式

blocks.en: Apply exceeds Analyze across all eight open-weight series in both settings ( H3 ), but the magnitude of the drop varies sharply with series and size bucket. A “cliff” denotes a statistically supported drop whose lower 95% relation-cluster bootstrap bound exceeds 10 percentage points. At Large, Granite exhibits a 47.2-point drop, whereas Qwen3.5 drops only 7.2 points. Neither Gemini model exhibits the Apply-to-Analyze accuracy drop observed across the evaluated open-weight model series. Across open-weight series, the cliff is neither scale-invariant nor monotonic with model size.
blocks.zh: 在两种设置(H3)中应用超过所有8个开放量级系列的Analysis,但下降的幅度随序列和大小桶而大相径庭. “cliff”表示在统计上支持的下降,其较低的95%关系-集群靴子约束值超过10个百分点。 在大项上,花岗岩显示47.2分下降,而Quen3.5则只下降7.2分. 双子座模型都没有显示在评估的开重模型系列中观察到的应用到分析的精度下降。 纵观开放的重量级系列,悬崖既无规模变异,也无单体模型大小.

blocks.en: Evaluate presents a different pattern ( H8 ). Gemini 3.1 Pro averages approximately 99.5% across the other four levels but only 60.7% on Evaluate, a gap of about 39 percentage points for a model that shows no Apply-to-Analyze drop at all. The Evaluate gap appears in all eight open-weight series and both Gemini models (Table 4 ). The two task types thus show different model-dependent accuracy patterns (§ 5 ); as noted in § 3.4 , these gaps are differences between operationalized task types and may partly reflect item and distractor construction.
blocks.zh: 评估呈现出不同的模式(H8 ) 。 双子座3.1 Pro在其他四个级别平均约为99.5%,但在评估中仅为60.7%,对于一个显示完全没有应用分析下降的模型来说,差距约为39个百分点。 评估差距出现在所有8个开放重量系列和双子座模型中(表4)。 因此,两种任务类型显示出不同的模型依赖准确性模式(§5);正如§3.4所指出,这些差距是可操作任务类型之间的差异,可能部分反映了项目和分心器构造。

blocks.en: 4.3 Veracity Effects
blocks.zh: 4.3 弹性效应

blocks.en: The full Neutralized > > Factual > > Counterfactual ordering ( H4 ) is common directionally but statistically supported in only a few size buckets and in no series as a whole. Counterfactual is generally the weakest condition, whereas Neutralized does not consistently exceed Factual and reverses in several high-capability models, including Qwen3.5, Gemma, and both Gemini models.
blocks.zh: 完全中立的 > > 事实 > 反事实订购(H4)在方向上是常见的,但统计上支持的只有几只大小桶,没有整个系列. 反事实通常是最弱的条件,而中立化在包括Qune3.5,Gemma,和双子座模型在内的几种高能力模型中并没有一贯地超过"事实"并反向.

blocks.en: The Factual–Counterfactual gap ( H5 ) also depends on cognitive demand. Its expected widening from lower to higher Bloom levels appears directionally in several open-weight series but is statistically supported in only a few size buckets. The effect is strongest for Gemini, where both models show significant widening despite near-ceiling performance on the lower-complexity levels.
blocks.zh: 事实-事实差距(H5)也取决于认知需求. 其预期从较低到较高水平的扩展在几个开放量级系列中呈现出方向性,但统计上只支持了几个大小桶. 对于双子座来说,效果最强,尽管在低复杂水平上表现的接近最高,但两种模型都显示出显著的扩张.

blocks.en: 4.4 Neutralization and Cognitive Demand
blocks.zh: 4.4 中立和认知需求

blocks.en: H7 compares the Neutralized-over-Factual advantage at Analyze and Evaluate with that at Remember and Understand. In the fully translated setting, the high-complexity advantage is significantly larger in the Small bucket for seven of eight open-weight series and remains present in several Medium and Large regimes.
blocks.zh: H7将分析和评价时的中性超事实优势与记忆和理解时的优势进行比较. 在完全被翻译的环境下,"小桶"中高复杂度的优势明显较大,为8个开口量系列中的7个,并且仍然存在于多个中大政权中.

blocks.en: The effect weakens or reverses in some stronger series: it remains substantial for Qwen2.5 Base and Instruct, becomes smaller for Qwen3, and is absent or reversed for several of the strongest models, including Gemini 3.1 Pro. Support for H7 is therefore recurrent but not universal, varying across model series and size buckets.
blocks.zh: 该效应在一些更强的系列中减弱或倒置:对Quen2.5 Base和Instruct仍然相当可观,对Quen3来说变小了,对包括双子座3.1 Pro在内的几个最强型号来说则不存在或倒置. 因此,对H7的支持是经常性的,但并非普遍性的,因型号系列和大小桶而异.

blocks.en: 4.5 Relation Usage Frequency
blocks.zh: 4.5 关系使用频率

blocks.en: H6 receives limited support. Although several Medium and Large buckets exhibit observed Low/Medium/High spreads below five percentage points, no open-weight series satisfies the stronger interval-based equivalence criterion in the fully translated setting. Gemini 3.1 Pro also shows a small observed spread, whereas Gemini 3 Flash lies at the five-point boundary under the rounded result. We therefore regard the influence of relation usage frequency as inconclusive rather than absent. Because the tiers reflect Wikidata property counts, this result says nothing about pretraining exposure or memorization strength.
blocks.zh: H6得到的支持有限. 虽然观测到一些中大桶的低度/中度/高分差低于5个百分点,但在全译出的情况下,没有开放重量系列符合更强的间隔等同标准。 双子座3.1 Pro也显示一个小的被观测到的分布,而双子座3 Flash则位于圆形结果下五分边界. 因此,我们认为关系使用频率的影响是没有结果的,而不是没有结果的。 因为分级反映Wikidata属性计数,这个结果没有说预受训练暴露或记忆强度.

blocks.en: 4.6 Cross-Language Stability
blocks.zh: 4.6 语文稳定

blocks.en: Item-level difficulty rankings ( H9 ) show consistently positive cross-language stability across every model series and size bucket in both settings and for both Gemini models. Significance alone does not convey strength: in the fully translated setting, the mean pairwise correlation is approximately ρ = 0.54 \rho=0.54 for Gemini 3 Flash, a moderate level of agreement, and ρ = 0.74 \rho=0.74 for Gemini 3.1 Pro, a strong one.
blocks.zh: 项目级难度排名(H9)显示,在两种情况下以及双子座模型中,每个模型系列和大小桶都始终保持正跨语言稳定性。 光是意义并不表示强度:在被完全翻译的设定中,双子座3 Flash的正对比相对比大约为 $ 0.54\rho=0.54,协议程度中等;双子座3.1 Pro的正对比为 $ 0.74,是强.

blocks.en: Relation-level difficulty rankings ( H10 ) show the same pattern: all series, size buckets, and both Gemini models exhibit significantly positive cross-language stability. Thus, differences in aggregate accuracy coexist with a difficulty structure that is partly shared across languages. Because all language versions derive from the same English items and translated templates, shared item construction may contribute to these correlations, as may the single triple per relation. The results establish stability for the evaluated relation instances, not language-independent reasoning ability in general.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: 5.1 How Analyze and Evaluate Items Differ
blocks.zh: 5.1 如何分析和评估项目差异

blocks.en: The two task types show different model-dependent accuracy patterns. The Apply-to-Analyze drop varies with series and size and is absent for Gemini, whereas the Evaluate gap persists for every series and both Gemini models. Their difficulty is therefore not captured by a single smooth progression across levels, although this alone does not show that they tap different underlying abilities: a harder task can remain hard after an easier one saturates.
blocks.zh: 这两个任务类型显示出不同的模型依赖的精度模式. 应用到分析的下降因系列和大小而异,双子座没有,而每系列和双子座模型的评价差距仍然存在。 因此,他们的困难不能被跨层级的单一平稳进展所抓住,尽管仅仅这一点并不能表明他们利用了不同的基础能力:一个较简单的饱和度之后,一项更艰巨的任务仍然可能难以完成。

blocks.en: The operationalization in Table 1 offers one account that is consistent with this pattern, though our experiments do not isolate it. Analyze distractors are near-miss relations that are inconsistent with the stated fact, so an item can in principle be solved by checking each option against the evidence. Evaluate distractors are consistent with the fact but are not the defining criterion of the relation, so such checking does not eliminate them.
blocks.zh: 表1中的可操作性提供了一个符合这一模式的账户,尽管我们的实验并不孤立它。 分析分心器是和所宣称的事实不一致的近乎误差关系,因此一个物品原则上可以通过对照证据检查每个选项来解决. 评估分散注意力者符合事实,但不是确定关系的标准,因此,这种检查并不能消除它们。

blocks.en: An equally important alternative is distractor plausibility: Evaluate distractors are by construction more plausible, and the gap may reflect discrimination among harder alternatives rather than a distinct operation. Separating these accounts requires items that vary distractor plausibility within a fixed level. “Definitional” criteria are also partly conventional, so some Evaluate errors may reflect reasonable disagreement with the key despite manual review and independent model cross-checks (Appendix A.5 ). We therefore report the Analyze–Evaluate contrast as a difference between operationalized task types, not between cognitive capabilities.
blocks.zh: 另一个同样重要的办法是分散注意力: 评价分散注意力者的方法是建筑更合理,这种差距可能反映较困难的替代办法之间的差别,而不是一种独特的操作。 分拆这些账户需要在固定水平内改变分散注意力者可信度的项目。 “定义”标准也部分具有常规性,因此,尽管进行了人工审查和独立的模式交叉核对(附录A.5.),但有些评估错误可能反映了对钥匙的合理分歧。 因此,我们将分析-评估对比报告为可操作任务类型之间的区别,而不是认知能力之间的区别。

blocks.en: 5.2 The Effect of Entity Cues Depends on Task Complexity
blocks.zh: 5.2 实体库斯的影响取决于任务的复杂性

blocks.en: Averaged over Remember and Understand, Neutralized contexts usually underperform Factual contexts across model-series and size-bucket combinations, suggesting that entity names can provide useful cues for simpler tasks. At Analyze and Evaluate, the pattern often reverses, consistent with entity-specific associations becoming more disruptive as relational demands increase.
blocks.zh: 平均于记忆和理解,中立的上下文通常在模型序列和大小桶组合中表现不佳的事实上下文,表明实体名称可以为更简单的任务提供有用的提示. 在分析和评估时,这种模式往往会逆转,因为随着关系需求的增加,针对具体实体的协会会变得更加具有破坏性。

blocks.en: This crossover underlies H7. One possibility is that familiar entities help locate the stated fact at lower levels but supply competing associations when the task concerns the relation itself. The Neutralized advantage shrinks in several higher-performing series, consistent with stronger models being less affected by such competition. Because this comparison is exploratory and rests on one source triple for each of 30 relations, we neither interpret it as a scaling law nor claim it generalizes to other triples of the same relations.
blocks.zh: 这种交叉构成H7的基础. 一种可能性是,熟悉的实体帮助在较低级别找到所述事实,但在涉及关系本身的任务时提供相互竞争的协会。 中立优势在几个性能较高的系列中收缩了,与较强的模型受这种竞争影响较小相一致. 由于这种比较是探索性的,而且每30个关系中有一个三重来源,我们既不把它解释为一个缩放法,也不声称它泛指同一关系中的其他三重来源。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: We presented Rel-Bloom , a controlled multilingual diagnostic of evidence-conditioned relational reasoning over matched relations, Bloom-inspired task types, and veracity conditions. Its results identify limitations in evidence-conditioned relational reasoning that may affect the reliability of downstream RAG systems.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了雷尔-布卢姆(Rel-Bloom), 一种有控制的多语种诊断, 其结果查明了可能影响下游RAG系统可靠性的证据条件关系推理的局限性。

blocks.en: They suggest three concrete practices for evaluating RAG systems. First, report accuracy separately by the operation a question requires: a system that reliably checks retrieved relations against the question (Analyze) may still fail to identify which retrieved property justifies an answer (Evaluate), and aggregate accuracy hides this. Second, include counterfactual and entity-neutralized variants of retrieved passages, since accuracy on factual passages alone conflates evidence-following with prior knowledge about the entities involved. Third, since difficulty rankings transfer across languages here, a translated item set can serve as a first multilingual screen, though language-specific accuracy must still be measured directly.
blocks.zh: 它们建议了三种具体做法,用以评价RAG系统。 首先,一个问题要求按操作分别报告准确性:一个可靠地对照问题(分析)检查检索到的关系的系统仍然可能无法确定哪些检索到的财产证明答案(评价)是正确的,而汇总准确性掩盖了这一点。 第二,包括取回的段落的反事实和实体中性变体,因为仅事实段落的准确性就将证据混为一谈,同时事先了解所涉实体。 第三,由于难度排名会在这里跨语言的传输,一个被翻译的项目集可以作为第一个多语种屏幕,尽管语言特定准确性仍然必须直接测量.

blocks.en: Rel-Bloom favors controlled comparison over breadth. With one source triple per relation, the 30 relation clusters give limited power for small effects (notably H6) and for generalizing to unseen triples of the same relations. We do not measure end-to-end RAG with noisy retrieval or open-ended generation. Level-wise gaps may reflect item construction; memorization is not measured; size comparisons are descriptive; shared templates may inflate cross-language correlations; and the error analysis uses one checkpoint. Future work can add triples per relation and vary distractor plausibility within levels.
blocks.zh: Rel-Bloom喜欢控制宽度的比较。 由于每个关系有一个三重源,30个关系集群对小效应(特别是H6)和将同一关系的三重效应概括到看不见的三重效应赋予了有限的权力。 我们不用噪音检索或无限制的一代来测量端到端的RAG. 水平相差可能反映项目构造;不计量记忆;大小比较是描述性的;共享模板可能放大跨语言的关联;错误分析使用一个检查点. 未来的工作可以在每个关系上增加三重并在各个级别内改变分心器的可信度.

blocks.en: H6 is an equivalence hypothesis rather than a directional hypothesis. We therefore use the predefined five-percentage-point equivalence region and assess whether the relation-cluster bootstrap intervals for the relevant pairwise usage-frequency contrasts lie entirely inside that region.

blocks.en: For H10, significance is evaluated using a relation-identity permutation test. blocks.en: A.4 Benchmark Construction Details
blocks.zh: A.4 基准建筑细节

blocks.en: We construct a candidate pool of Wikidata properties starting from the relations in Wikidata5M ( Wang et al., 2021 ) . For each relation, we take its primary English alias as a human-readable handle, deduplicate, and randomly shuffle the resulting list using a fixed seed, retaining up to N = 1000 N{=}1000 candidates for downstream sampling. We estimate relation usage frequency by querying the MediaWiki search API with haswbstatement:PID and using the returned totalhits as a proxy. This measures the prevalence of the property in Wikidata-indexed content and should not be interpreted as a direct estimate of model pretraining exposure. We apply a log ⁡ ( 1 + hits ) \log(1+\text{hits}) transformation to reduce skew and split values into tertiles, defining Low, Medium, and High usage tiers. We then sample up to 30 properties per tier using a fixed random seed, yielding a candidate pool of up to 90 properties for manual curation.
blocks.zh: 我们从Wikidata5M中的关系开始构建一个 Wikidata 属性候选集合 (王等,2021年) (中文(简体) ). 对于每种关系,我们用其主要的英文别名作为人可读的手柄,去重复,并用固定的种子随机地洗去所产生的清单,保留了最多为N=1000N{=}1000的下游采样候选人. 我们通过查询 MediaWiki 搜索 API 的hawbreatment 来估计关系使用频率: PID 并使用返回的 tollhits作为代理 。 这衡量了Wikidata-index内容中财产的普及程度,不应被解释为直接估计模型预训曝光. 我们应用一个对数( 1 + 点击)\ log( 1 + text{ hits}) 转换来减少skew 并分解值为tertiles, 定义低、 中和高使用级 。 然后,我们用固定的随机种子对每层多达30个属性进行取样,从而产生一个最多90个属性的候选集合,进行人工管理。

blocks.en: For each sampled property p p , we extract exactly one representative factual triple ( h , p , t ) (h,p,t) from popular English Wikipedia pages, ranked by sitelink count as a proxy for popularity. From the automatically sampled candidates, we manually curate a final set of 30 relations, 10 per usage tier, excluding relations involving sensitive topics, overly technical semantics, or cases where multiple relations feature the same entity. We prioritize semantic clarity and domain diversity across geography, science, engineering, sports, entertainment, and linguistics.
blocks.zh: 我们从流行的英语维基百科页面中提取一个具有代表性的事实三重(h, p, t (h, p,t)), 从自动抽样的候选人中,我们手动整理一套最终的30个关系,每层使用10个关系,不包括涉及敏感议题的关系,过于技术性的语义,或多个关系具有同一实体特征的情况。 我们把语义清晰度和领域多样性放在优先位置,跨越地理、科学、工程、体育、娱乐和语言学。

blocks.en: A.5 Item Quality Control
blocks.zh: A.5项 质量控制

blocks.en: All generated questions, answer options, and answer keys were manually reviewed by the authors for factual correctness, preservation of the intended relation, answer uniqueness, and distractor plausibility. As an additional quality-control step, every item was independently evaluated using Gemini and Grok. Each model received the fact sentence, question, answer options, and intended answer key and was asked to identify cases in which it disagreed with the provided answer. All flagged cases were manually inspected. When disagreement occurred, we examined whether it reflected model error or plausible ambiguity in the question or answer options. Valid objections led to revisions of wording or distractors, followed by re-evaluation before inclusion.
blocks.zh: 所有产生的问题、答案选项和答案密钥都由作者手动审查,以了解事实正确性、保留预期的关系、回答独特性以及分散注意力的可信度。 作为另一个质量控制步骤,每件物品都使用双子座和格罗克进行独立评价. 每个模型都收到了事实句子、提问、回答选项和打算的答案密钥,并被要求查明它不同意所提供的答案的情况。 所有标有标记的病例都经过人工检查。 当出现分歧时,我们研究了它是否反映了模型错误或问题或答案选项中可能存在的模糊之处。 有效的反对意见导致修改措辞或转移注意力,然后在列入之前重新评价。
